variants.title: A 金锋回旋
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: game VFX art direction board for an existing 2D landscape mobile survival game 桃园乱斗. This is a proposed VISUAL redesign, NOT a runtime screenshot.
Input images: Image 1 is a STYLE AND SCALE reference for the actual game battlefield, grass texture, small chibi yellow turban enemies and the main character. Image 2 is a reference of the CURRENT overly simple 横扫六合 effect, to improve substantially; do not merely repeat its thin ring. Image 3 is character design reference only; use ONLY Liu Bei from the left third of the first row; ignore the other characters and logos.
Subject: the exact same comical Liu Bei, green short robe, red waist sash, tied hair bun, mischievous thick eyebrows, blush cheeks, tiny feet, huge head and naturally bent short arms. Surrounded by 6-8 same-style yellow-turban sickle/hoe soldiers. Match dark warm-brown outlines, flat hand-painted cel colors and charming absurd Three Kingdoms style. No long legs, no realistic armor, no third arm.
Composition: high quality wide landscape 16:9 CONCEPT PRESENTATION. One large overhead 2D combat mockup occupies the top ~72%; bottom ~28% contains THREE clean little storyboard panels of the same effect: wind-up, peak impact, dissipating. Show ground context and readable enemies, not a cinematic camera. Enlarge the battlefield crop enough to clearly evaluate blade shapes, a face and impact silhouettes. Clear center around the hero face. Top modest cream-on-dark-jade title; simple very short captions under the three storyboard thumbnails.
Shared mechanic invariant: 横扫六合 is a single quick 360-degree circular melee sweep, centered on player, existing radius 250 world units, hero head about 100 units wide, so full effect outer diameter is about FIVE hero head widths. Do not draw a huge arena or increase the attack reach, do not imply lingering damage or extra strikes. Complete visual lasts about 0.4 seconds. At peak the slash is directional and asymmetric rather than a perfectly uniform ring: foreground blade rich and opaque, back arc softer and occluded behind character. 6 enemies hit at the edge show small crisp gold-white contact wedges, brief squash, recoil and little outward dust kicks; no gore, no huge explosions. Some unhit enemies stand beyond the radius unchanged. Ground and enemy silhouettes remain visible through gaps. No full-screen flash, no beam reaching beyond the circle, no giant dragon, no photorealistic bloom, no MMO rainbow aura, no magic runic targeting circle, no thick circular border pretending to be a slash. Preserve the game’s cartoony readable combat aesthetic.

Primary VFX direction A: GOLDEN EDGE ROTATION, the most tactile and recommended. An energetic, broad hand-painted crescent cleaves clockwise around Liu Bei. It has a bright cream-white razor leading edge, warm amber solid body fading to transparent ochre brush strokes, strong tapered tips, two thin offset directional afterimages and short tangential speed cuts. It reads as a sharp moving blade with thickness, NOT a neon hoop. The sweep forms an almost-complete 360 arc with a breathing gap/trailing dissolve; show one strong sweeping action in his torso and wrists. Short radiating grass blades and warm dust chips follow outward knockback. The thickest foreground crescent sits in front of his short robe but below his uncovered eyes and face. 4-5 crisp contact spark bursts align with the blade touching nearby soldiers, not scattered fireworks.
Bottom panels: 1 coiled little body, short gold pre-stroke; 2 broad fast asymmetric circular crescent with hit wedges; 3 broken fading gold brush trails and small gold chips while soldiers recoil. Timing implied visually, do not add damage numbers.
Text verbatim only: "A 金锋回旋" and under panels "蓄势" "横扫" "收势". No other text.

Six crisp, broad ivory-and-pale-jade crescent blade shapes occupy SIX tangential positions around the player in a single simultaneous sweeping pulse. Each has a sharp warm-gold cutting rim, dark jade inner shading, and short, curved speed tails; a broken faint golden circular motion connects them visually. Make them look like six sections of the SAME rapid 360-degree sweep, NOT six floating swords, not a permanent orbiting weapon, not a shuriken, not a star-shaped shield. Bottom panels: 1 six tiny gold edge glints appear around a coiled hero; 2 six staggered blade crescents sweep outward to the same fixed ring boundary and contact enemies in one pulse; 3 crescents dissolve into a handful of crisp jade-gold fragments. Do not imply 6 damage ticks or expanding range.
Text verbatim only: "B 六合六刃" and under panels "聚刃" "齐扫" "散锋". No other text.

Primary VFX direction C: INK AND GOLD COMIC SWEEP. A forceful thick tapered calligraphic brush crescent curves clockwise almost once around the hero, with warm ochre-gold painted middle, a very sharp ivory leading edge and a ragged dark-brown ink underside. A smaller broken secondary brush stroke recedes behind. Organic dry-brush streak gaps and 3-5 angular comic speed marks give a premium energetic martial-arts manga feel, still exactly matching the existing friendly cel-painted game. Use dark brown as a thin back edge and fragmented afterimage, not an opaque black disk. No written spell symbols, no calligraphic characters inside the battlefield, no giant rocks. Strongest peak shows grounded sweeping torque in Liu Bei's tiny body, knees/tiny feet braced, while 4 yellow turban soldiers compress and are pushed outward with small beige dust puffs. Keep the floor visible, character eye/face area clear and enemy outlines readable. No glow wash, emphasize SHAPE and VALUE rather than particle quantity.
Bottom panels: 1 small ink-gold brush start wraps the feet with a coiled stance; 2 broad single ivory-edged golden calligraphic slash and angular compact impact bursts; 3 fading dry-brush tail in short pieces and clear outward knockback dust. One attack pulse only.
Text verbatim only: "C 墨金破阵" and under panels "起势" "破阵" "余劲". No other text.
